1. (Currently Amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, wherein the surface portion is configured to hold a cosmetic product in a quantity greater than the quantity to be transferred to a destination;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette from a container;
d. spreading or blending the cosmetic product on the surface portion; and
e. transferring only a portion of the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination, wherein the portion transferred is less than the quantity deposited.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, wherein the first quantity is deliberately deposited in excess of the second quantity to be transferred.

5. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein:
a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and
b. the surface portion is free, from any first point on the outer perimeter to any second point on the outer perimeter, of features that could trap cosmetics and complicate cleaning of the surface portion.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein the surface portion is configured with a specific geometry that prevents cosmetic product from being trapped during use and cleaning.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar, and wherein the planar configuration facilitates controlled spreading and blending of cosmetic product prior to transfer to a destination.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and wherein the ring portion is sized and shaped to maintain the surface portion in a stable position relative to the finger during the spreading, blending, and transferring steps.
